title: Read the timeline
summary: The agent's one way to read the active Video Project's timeline: its revision, tracks, clips, effects, transitions, and whether an undo or a redo is available. It reads only; it never changes the Project.

carrier.notes: Reached by the agent through luc_invoke with capability_id timeline.inspect; the Runtime runs the packaged tool get_timeline.

replaceability.why: The package carries Python code the Runtime runs, so its own files stay as they shipped. A creator's layer may add a program that answers for a capability instead: it runs only in the code sandbox, reaches the Project only through ToolHost's calls over its pipe, and is held to this contract (docs/luc/tool-programs.md).
replaceability.decided: self-Luc spec v0.3 (2026-10-18): tool/v2 code is not replaceable this week; Acrab 2026-10-26: replaced by programs in the code sandbox

operations.name: get_timeline

timeline.description: The Project document's timeline, as stored. Its shape is the timeline document's interface (data area).

operations.notes: No deadline is enforced on a packaged read today; the call is one document read. The shipped output_schema is the bare {type: object} (luc_packaged_tools.py:556); this contract is the real one.

events.name: luc.module_fell_back
events.notes: Once per Session in a start, when a layer's program broke and the Official code answers instead.

bounds.name: agent_result_chars
bounds.unit: characters of the rendered result the model sees; longer is cut with a note

invariants.text: Calling it never changes the Project: the project revision before and after the call is the same.
Any argument is refused with arguments_invalid; nothing is read.
It is offered in safe mode and on a Host that cannot write the Project, where every timeline writing capability is absent.

break: A layer's program does not start, answers late, too large or out of shape, or ends.
It asks for a host call that does not exist, with other arguments, or more than 256 of them.
Its result does not keep the output schema, or its refusal names an error code not listed here.
failure.notes: The Official code answers the same call, and every call of this Luc for the rest of the start; the Session hears luc.module_fell_back once and luc_breaker counts one break. Without a program, a call that raises or refuses reaches the agent as a refusal.

conformance.notes: The tool is exercised by the timeline editor tests; no test validates its answer against this output schema yet. tests/test_luc_tool_program.py holds a replacement to this interface: the load gate, the answers the Runtime accepts, and the fallback to the Official code.

known_deviations.text: Only the agent's call goes to a layer's program. Where the editor asks a packaged tool directly through the Worker's own routes, the Official code answers.
Stopping the turn does not stop a program mid-call; the 10 s deadline per answer and the bound of 256 host calls end it.
